case.summary: The case was opened after Chakravyuh flagged a rare device profile used on 28 cards, including card C10326-K1, and the investigation found that the device was used to make online purchases on 25 different cards within about a month. The evidence shows the same device profile was new to the card, had never been seen before, and was linked to 24 other cards, indicating a coordinated fraud scheme. The fraud probability is 0.99 and the case was escalated to a fraud analyst. The analyst confirmed the shared device profile links 24 other cards with the same activity and agreed it is one coordinated scheme. The card was blocked, the transaction declined, the case was created, connected cards were monitored, a report was filed, and the case was escalated to an analyst.

sar.narrative: Between 2016-11-14 16:54 and 2016-11-14 18:13, card C10326-K1 held by customer C10326 was used for 2 online transaction(s) totalling $262.92 (transaction IDs 3457285, 3457521). The activity came to the bank's attention through an analyst request on 2016-11-14 16:54:00, referring to transaction 3457285 for $159.30. The transactions were billed in region code(s) 181 (country code 87 unless noted), and the purchaser email domain was yahoo.com. Online activity used the device profile SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080. The activity fits none of the bank's five documented fraud patterns. Device-ring fraud: one device profile, behind an anonymous proxy and flagged as a New device on almost every use, made online purchases on 25 different cards within about a month, one to three purchases per card. It matches none of the five documented patterns because the link is the shared device across unrelated customers, not any one cardholder's behaviour; the bank's own history labels the same profile undocumented (CC-2985, CC-3035, CC-2971). The same scheme links to other cards, which have been placed under monitoring: C01289-K1, C01996-K2, C02910-K1, C02975-K1, C03676-K2, C04108-K2, C04274-K1, C05448-K2, C06031-K2, C06710-K1, C08168-K1, C09049-K1, C09195-K1, C09906-K1, C09975-K1, C10020-K1, C10193-K2, C11082-K1, C11670-K2, C11702-K1, C12645-K1, C12796-K1, C13291-K1, C13487-K1. Analyst confirms the shared device profile links 24 other cards with the same activity in the window and agrees it is one coordinated scheme. The card has been recommended for blocking and reissue, and the total suspicious amount reported is $262.92.
